inputs.prompt: Vintage analogue film photograph, a surreal scene in which an entire person is completely wrapped and obscured by a large soft white cumulus cloud. The cloud covers the head, face, shoulders and most of the upper body so that no human facial features are visible at all, no eyes, no nose, no mouth, no skin, no hair. Only a loose blue-and-white floral shirt and the shape of a seated figure can be faintly perceived beneath the cloud. The person sits sideways at an old wooden classroom desk, beside a large wooden window frame with pale blue sky outside. Soft daylight falls from the window, creating a quiet dreamy nostalgic atmosphere, muted retro pastel colors, subtle film grain, soft focus, gentle haze, minimalist surreal photography, photorealistic, 8K.
